title: Onomappu — [EN&JP Sub] NO Kansai Dialect Game！ft. Native Kansai Speaker
description: A 'try not to use Kansai-ben' game featuring a native Kansai speaker naturally demonstrating the differences between standard Tokyo Japanese and Kansai-ben (Osaka dialect). The speaker attempts to speak standard Japanese but frequently reverts to Kansai-ben, providing natural, sentence-level contrasts perfect for learners who want to hear how the dialect actually differs from standard Japanese in real conversation.
creator: Onomappu (Hitoki)
